svg.title: Agentic Stock Contributor: one batch from buyer question to Adobe outcome
svg.desc: A ten-stage visual process showing research, planning, generation, two quality gates, packaging, guarded staging, human submission and evidence-backed learning.
svg.text: One stock batch, from buyer need to evidence
The agent researches and drafts. The toolkit measures and verifies. The contributor approves and clicks Submit.

g.text: Split the market into buyer jobs
Create one canary, then the set
No source defect or brief miss

svg.text: Adobe outcomes become evidence for the next research pass
CAPTCHA · sign-in · restriction · 403/429 · hash mismatch · partial staging
